subject: design/config-driven-portability-v1
statement: cross-field validation folds into config load — the engine either loads a valid configuration or refuses by name, before any resolution, reusing the existing closed-schema fail-closed refusal path (INV-32; `design-brainstorm:…#D-4`). The in-repo check is **lexical**: a configured path is refused at load if it is absolute, contains a parent-directory escape, or is otherwise not a repository-relative path. The engine only ever joins a config path under the repository root and never follows a config value as an absolute location.
